Priya Kapoor: Quick async — closing out INC-925 postmortem actions. I pulled the action list and a few items still need owners + due dates. Can folks confirm by EOD PT?
Dan Foley: I can take the 'k8s autoscaler tuning' item, but want to push the due to next Wed if that's ok. dependency on eng-infra runbook.
Miguel Santos: Assigning yourself is fine @Dan. I'll own the 'ingress timeout regression' (investigate, add test). Targeting Tue.
Sara Liu: I can own the 'alerting threshold adjustments' but need a day to sync with SRE. propose Thu COB.
Alice Chen: I grabbed 'post-deploy smoke job' (small script + CI check). ETA tomorrow morning.
Ben Ortiz: Re: the client SDK retry change — I'll do a quick PR. Can I aim for today? If yes, please mark as high-priority.
incident-bot: Added comment to tracker: https://tracker.internal/INC-925/actions (automated)
Priya Kapoor: Thanks all. I'll update the tracker once everyone confirms. Quick table I'm pasting for clarity — reply with "ACK" + preferred due if different: 
```
ID  | Action                                 | Owner         | Due (proposed)
----|----------------------------------------|---------------|----------------
A1  | k8s autoscaler tuning                  | Dan Foley     | 2026-04-07
A2  | ingress timeout regression tests       | Miguel Santos | 2026-04-06
A3  | alerting threshold adjustments         | Sara Liu      | 2026-04-08
A4  | post-deploy smoke job + CI             | Alice Chen    | 2026-04-02
A5  | client SDK retry change                | Ben Ortiz     | 2026-04-01
```
Priya Kapoor: Also note A1 depends on eng-infra's migration window (blocked until 2026-04-05). If that slips, we stagger A1 and A2.
Dan Foley: ACK, 2026-04-07 works for me. I'll add a short runbook fragment under /docs/runbooks/autoscale.md and ping infra.
Miguel Santos: ACK. I'll write the regression test and leave notes in the PR template. If I hit infra rate-limit, will escalate here.
Sara Liu: ACK, but prefer 2026-04-09 if infra needs more time. Marking 2026-04-09 tentative.
Alice Chen: ACK, will open PR this afternoon.
Ben Ortiz: ACK, aiming EOD today. If any blocker, I'll post update here.
Priya Kapoor: OK — I'll update the tracker and set reminders for owners 24h before due. One more ask: if you expect a slip, @mention in this thread so we can reassign quickly. :thumbsup:
Dan Foley: FYI I'm going to run the autoscaler test in the staging cluster later — will paste logs here.
Miguel Santos: also adding a short verification checklist to the action card (smoke + latency histogram).
incident-bot: Reminder set: owners will be notified 24h before due dates.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks team. If nobody objects, I'll lock these owners in by EOD and follow up in the all-hands postmortem doc. :eyes:
